title: Spinnet Candidate Contract declarations
description: The candidate_contracts member a manifest adds to the stable manifest to declare the exact Candidate Contract revisions the Plugin was written against. It is not part of any stable Plugin API Level: the stable manifest schema refuses it. Check the manifest without this member against ../../schemas/manifest.schema.json, and with it against this schema. The Host also refuses a name declared twice.

name.description: A Candidate Contract's name: a lowercase letter, then lowercase letters, digits or underscores, at most 64 characters.

declaration.description: One exact revision. The Host runs the Plugin only if it provides this revision; a lower or higher one is a mismatch.
